jump_convention.source: Exercise-05: user subsequently confirmed two sets of 10 jumps, the first before pressing Space, and described jumping with arms raised. Each detected bout has 20 impact pulses; the calibrated paired-impact convention yields 10 repetitions per bout. This describes the observed counting unit, not proven jump biomechanics.

limitations: Personal development model; no independent blind accuracy established.
Sensor orientation and placement must match the references.
Standing and sitting are deliberately combined; upper-arm motion does not establish posture.
Stairs direction, tread count and handrail use are not established by the activity label.
Feature distance is not a probability; similar unseen activity may be mistaken.
Activity boundaries have about two seconds of window context; brief transitions are uncertain.
Jump pulse pairing depends on the declared counting convention; no body-flight measurement is available.
Short pull-up counts describe arm excursions, including flagged incomplete returns, not verified technique.
